nodes.name: skill_db.py
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed persistent knowledge store for the Virtuoso SKILL API (virtuoso-gui-debug skill). Defines DB_PATH and exposes connection management plus CRUD helpers: get_db (lazy schema creation for functions, error_history, layers, shapes, fnd_functions, param_examples tables), record_function, record_failure, has_known_failure, get_known_functions, get_function, record_layer, record_shape_property, record_param_example, get_param_examples, and stats. Each writer stamps an ISO timestamp and commits; readers project sqlite3.Row rows into dicts. Forms the persistence layer every other script in this skill imports.
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 with stdlib sqlite3 only; uses Path for filesystem layout, dict-row projection via sqlite3.Row. No third-party deps. ~215 lines, 11 functions, no classes.

nodes.name: get_db
nodes.summary: Opens (creating if needed) the SQLite database at DB_PATH and ensures the full schema (functions, error_history, layers, shapes, fnd_functions, param_examples) exists via idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements. Returns a connection with row_factory=sqlite3.Row.

nodes.name: record_function
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a row in the functions table for a discovered SKILL function, splitting the dotted name into category prefix and writing existence flag, signature, description, notes, and a current ISO timestamp.
nodes.languageNotes: Lines 69-85; ~17 lines, single INSERT OR REPLACE.

nodes.name: record_failure
nodes.summary: Logs a probe failure into error_history with error_type, error_message, and an ISO timestamp, used to track which functions are known broken so future runs skip them.

nodes.name: has_known_failure
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent unresolved error_history row for a given function_name (fixed=0) or None if there is no open failure. Used to short-circuit re-probing of broken functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Lines 97-104; SELECT with LIMIT 1, dict projection.

nodes.name: get_known_functions
nodes.summary: Lists known-working SKILL functions. Overload: with a category argument returns rows for that category only; without it returns all func_exists=1 rows ordered by category, name. Each row is projected to a dict.
nodes.languageNotes: Lines 107-116; two SELECT branches based on whether category is provided.

nodes.name: record_param_example
nodes.summary: Records a working example value for a parameter of a SKILL function, incrementing its success_count via a conditional UPDATE (or inserting a new row) so frequently-successful examples bubble to the top of get_param_examples results.
nodes.languageNotes: Lines 149-168; ~20 lines combining UPDATE-then-INSERT and a trailing commit.

nodes.name: stats
nodes.summary: Aggregates row counts across all tables (functions, functions where func_exists=1, drawable layers, working shapes, fnd_functions, unresolved error_history) and formats them as a multi-line summary string with str() casts.
nodes.languageNotes: Lines 191-207; six COUNT(*) SELECTs and string assembly.

nodes.name: enumerate_functions.py
nodes.summary: Discovers SKILL functions by name pattern for the virtuoso-gui-debug skill. Generates candidate names from prefix x entity combinations (build_candidates), probes each candidate by invoking `name()` via vcli skill exec (test_function, classifies 'undefined' vs arg-count error responses), and orchestrates a filtered run with optional --session and --prefix CLI args (run_enumeration). Every successful probe is recorded through skill_db.record_function, while known-broken functions are skipped via has_known_failure.
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 script using subprocess.run to shell out to vcli, json.loads to parse responses, and argparse for CLI. Imports get_db/record_function/record_layer/record_shape_property from sibling skill_db. ~157 lines, 3 functions, no classes.

nodes.name: test_function
nodes.summary: Calls a single SKILL function name via vcli skill exec with no args, parses the JSON envelope, classifies the response (undefined function vs arg-count error vs generic failure), and lower-cases a combined stdout+stderr snippet for downstream matching. Returns a JSON-friendly result tuple/dict.
nodes.languageNotes: Lines 62-109; ~48 lines, subprocess + JSON parsing, multiple decision branches.

nodes.name: run_enumeration
nodes.summary: Driver that opens the DB, builds the candidate list (optionally filtered by prefix), iterates with progress reporting, calls test_function for each candidate, and persists results through record_function. Prints progress counts at intervals and a final summary.
nodes.languageNotes: Lines 112-143; ~32 lines, the entrypoint function for the script.

nodes.name: probe_signatures.py
nodes.summary: Reverse-engineers SKILL function argument counts by invoking each known function with 0..5 nil arguments and parsing the error message to recover the expected arity and a cleaned signature string. Wraps a per-function probe (probe_signature) and a batch driver (run_signature_probe) that reads the candidate list from skill_db.get_known_functions, threads Popen subprocess calls with a short timeout, and stores results back via skill_db.record_function.
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 using subprocess.Popen + communicate, re.search for arity regex, and sqlite3 rows via skill_db. ~94 lines, 2 functions, no classes.

nodes.name: probe_signature
nodes.summary: Calls a single SKILL function with 0..5 nil arguments via vcli, collects the resulting error messages, regex-extracts the expected argument count, and returns (arg_count, signature) or (None, None) when no signal is recoverable.
nodes.languageNotes: Lines 16-57; ~42 lines, Popen + communicate + re.search + int coercion.

nodes.name: run_signature_probe
nodes.summary: Batch driver: loads candidate functions from skill_db (filtered by --limit), calls probe_signature on each, aggregates results into a per-category signature summary, and persists updated records back through record_function. Prints per-stage progress and totals.
